description: The Blue Racer ricochets through seventeen theatrical shorts in pursuit of food, affection and dignity, usually finding the Japanese Beetle or another animal ready to turn his schemes back on him.

s01e01.description: The Blue Racer would rather avoid work, but hunger and family obligations send him searching for food with predictably exhausting results.

s01e02.description: The Japanese Beetle offers friendship to the Racer, who interprets the opportunity mainly as another chance to turn the Beetle into lunch.

s01e03.description: A hungry Racer pursues the Japanese Beetle through a village as the Beetle repeatedly recruits local help against his predator.

s01e04.description: After an energetic start to his day, the Racer goes hunting for a meal and runs headlong into the Beetle's martial-arts defenses.

s01e05.description: While visiting Japan, the Racer's pursuit of the Beetle expands into a chain of encounters with local animals, including an elephant willing to intervene.

s01e06.description: The Japanese Beetle tries to photograph the countryside while the Racer repeatedly interrupts the excursion with fresh attempts to eat him.

s01e07.description: The Racer raids a Japanese chicken farm for an egg and discovers that acquiring breakfast is considerably harder than spotting it.

s01e08.description: Lonely rather than hungry, the Racer goes into the city seeking affection and attention with reluctant assistance from the Beetle.

s01e09.description: Aided by a calypso-singing bee, the Racer tries to win his girlfriend back from a muscular boa constrictor.

s01e10.description: An egg hunt goes spectacularly wrong when the Racer awakens an ancient dragon and must improvise ways to escape it.

s01e11.description: Washed onto an Irish island, the Racer encounters leprechauns and a Great Shillelagh whose principal duty is keeping snakes away.

s01e12.description: Tired of crawling, the Racer seeks magical help to become taller and instead ends up dealing with an airborne transformation he never asked for.

s01e13.description: The Racer's attempt to sleep is ruined when he is pressed into entertaining a demanding young chick for an equally demanding parent.

s01e14.description: Freezing weather drives the Racer into a warm cabin, where his effort to stay comfortable becomes an escalating battle with its occupant.

s01e15.description: Starving again, the Racer tries to steal an egg from Crazylegs Crane and manages to anger both the bird and a bumblebee.

s01e16.description: Crazylegs Crane searches for a bumblebee to satisfy his expectant wife's craving, only to discover the Racer wants the same insect for himself.

s01e17.description: Unhappy with being a snake, the Racer follows an owl psychiatrist's advice and attempts to live out his secret ambition of becoming a sheepdog.
